fact: EAC central bank governors validated in May 2025 a roadmap for a regional cross-border payment switch by 2030 covering the DRC, with national switches interconnected by 2028; sending money from the DRC to Uganda by mobile money costs about 5 percent in fees.
title: CAE : vers des paiements plus rapides et moins couteux entre la RDC et sept pays d ici 2030
